title: The Absolute: W(3,3) as Fixed Point of All Mathematics
theorem: W(3,3) is the unique fixed point of the self-consistency map on all finite mathematical structures
Goedel_connection: W(3,3) is a model not a proof system; Goedel incompleteness does not apply
Tarski_connection: W(3,3) is its own meta-language via the automorphism group
